The speech therapist clearly models a rounded lip shape with a finger pointing to her OWN lips; the client watches and imitates the mouth position, using the mirror for feedback. Show their full figures and seats; no touching mouths, masks, writing, white coat badges, mouth diagrams or letters. Plain unmarked shoes. A woman speech therapist in a muted blue cardigan and a school-age child in a yellow top, sitting on two chairs. Child holds small round mirror to see own lips, therapist models the sound with round mouth. One picture-only apple card. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
